donor_disposition.adapt: Direct /home entries (mindepth=1,maxdepth=1; decision 23.09.2026, supersedes the earlier v2 all-passwd-rows model) are the home population; within each home only direct entries whose name belongs to the closed built-in name set (the eight source names plus common shell basenames) are checked (decision 23.09.2026, step (b)).
donor_disposition.reject: Interactive-only UID_MIN/shell filtering and inventory-only completeness are rejected after retrospective counterexamples. The local augmentation authority file and recursive relative-path discovery are removed (decision 23.09.2026, step (b)): the name set is closed and built into the adapter.
donor_disposition.reuse: Donor exact chmod go-rwx relation (mode & 0077 == 0) and the eight explicit source-example names.

evidence_scope: Seven privileged read-only VM runs exercised the earlier all-passwd-rows population heuristic and direct source-example discovery. Evidence supports implementation assumptions; it does not turn observed host modes into normative policy and belongs to the accepted supported runtime matrix. The home population source changed 23.09.2026 (decision: direct /home entries, not /etc/passwd); vm_evidence below predates that change and its candidate_accounts field describes the old passwd-based counting model, not the current homes= count. The authority file and recursive discovery were removed 23.09.2026 (step (b): closed built-in name set, direct entries of each home only); related_discovery_entries below predates that change.

non_requirements.file_contents: No sensitive file contents are read or emitted.
non_requirements.home_mode: Home directory mode 0700 belongs to SRC-0015 and is not added to SRC-0014.
non_requirements.ownership: Owner/group equality is evidence only and is not added to SRC-0014.
non_requirements.passwd_home_field: The home= field of /etc/passwd has no effect on this control: population comes exclusively from direct (mindepth=1,maxdepth=1) entries of /home (decision 23.09.2026).

permissions_control.comparison: For each present regular selected file, mode & 0077 == 0; this is the exact chmod go-rwx relation.
permissions_control.fail: VALUE/FAIL when one or more present sensitive files have any group/other rwx bit.
permissions_control.pass: VALUE/PASS when the population is fully evaluated and violations=0.

population.absent_root: /home missing, with a searchable ancestor => VALUE/PASS, homes=0;discovered=0;checked=0;violations=0 (ERROR home-base:ancestor-symlink / home-base:ancestor-invalid-type / home-base:ancestor-unsearchable when the ancestor itself is not a searchable directory).
population.authority: Direct entries of /home (find -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1); /etc/passwd is not read at all.
population.entry_state: Each direct entry must be a real, readable, searchable directory and must not be a symlink (symlinks are never followed for type classification): a symlink entry => ERROR home:symlink:<path>-><readlink target> (target omitted only when readlink itself fails); any other non-directory type => ERROR home:not-directory:<path>; unreadable/unsearchable directory => ERROR home:unreadable / home:unsearchable. An entry name or symlink target containing a tab, CR, LF or DEL byte would corrupt the tab-delimited wire row, so that object is reported as ERROR home:invalid-name instead of embedding the raw bytes.
population.home_base_not_directory: /home existing but not a directory => ERROR home-base:invalid-type.
population.home_base_symlink: /home itself being a symlink => ERROR home-base:symlink (not followed).
population.scan_failure: A read error enumerating /home (EACCES, etc.) => ERROR home-scan:find-failed / home-scan:sort-failed / home-scan:missing-marker / home-scan:invalid-marker, never a mutation-eligible PASS on a partial population.

sensitive_file_population.depth: Only direct entries of each home (find -P -xdev -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1) are selected by name; files below the first level of the home directory are out of scope.
sensitive_file_population.name_set: Closed built-in set: mandatory_source_names plus common_shell_basenames; no authority file is read. Broad patterns such as *rc/*env are forbidden because they capture unrelated application files such as .vimrc.
sensitive_file_population.symlink_policy: Any selected symlink or nonregular object => ERROR; regular targets are not followed outside the home.
sensitive_file_population.traversal: find/sort/stat ambiguity => ERROR; partial PASS prohibited.
